import json
from ghidra.app.decompiler import DecompInterface
prog = currentProgram
out = {"sha256": str(prog.getExecutableSHA256())}
addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress("0x1409393b0")
fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
f = fm.getFunctionAt(addr)
if f is None:
    raise RuntimeError("absent")
out["name"] = str(f.getName()); out["signature"] = str(f.getSignature())
d = DecompInterface()
try:
    d.openProgram(prog)
    res = d.decompileFunction(f, 60, monitor)
    out["decompiled"] = res.getDecompiledFunction().getC() if res.decompileCompleted() else None
finally:
    d.dispose()
# also callers
refmgr = prog.getReferenceManager()
callers = []
for r in refmgr.getReferencesTo(addr):
    monitor.checkCancelled()
    if not r.getReferenceType().isCall(): continue
    ca = r.getFromAddress(); cf = fm.getFunctionContaining(ca)
    callers.append([str(ca), str(cf.getEntryPoint()) if cf else "", str(cf.getName()) if cf else ""])
out["callers"] = callers
print(json.dumps(out))
